symptoms: Extremity compression/trauma, swelling, muscle weakness, dark urine (myoglobinuria), hyperkalaemia, metabolic acidosis

management_steps.details: Crystalloid fluids (Balsol or Ringer's Lactate): 15-30 ml/kg/hr IV. Target urine output: 200-300 mls/hr.
Mannitol if urine output < 20 mls/hr despite fluid resuscitation. Sodium Bicarbonate 8.5%: 1 ml/kg IV for severe acidosis or hyperkalaemia.

warnings: Monitor continuously for severe hyperkalaemia upon release of compression.
